decisive_items: Blood culture positive with grayish white colonies on blood agar and green colonies on TCBS agar
tenderness of the left lumbar vertebra
response.rationale: Green colonies on TCBS agar from blood culture in a cirrhotic patient are characteristic of Vibrio vulnificus infection; fever and lumbar vertebral tenderness reflect metastatic septic complications. Pyogenic spondylitis is a local manifestation rather than the underlying diagnosis, and SBP is not supported by the ascites cell count.

rejected.why: Ascites cell count of 200/μL is not clearly diagnostic of SBP and does not explain the TCBS-positive blood culture.
Lumbar tenderness and low back pain are local features of metastatic infection but do not identify the causative organism.
